div.head: Had 7
div.ab: 7 to hadbote, gif fullbryce wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam syxtan stæpe VI pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
In sexto gradu, si ordinis infractio fiat (infracto gradu), supra rectam weram, emendet sex libris (VI libre emendentur) cum (digna) penitentia.
And to hadbote, gif fulbrice wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam VI. stæpe VI pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.

And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if a full breach occurs, one must pay for the sixth degree with six pounds in addition to the legal wergild, and intercede zealously with ecclesiastical penance.
And as compensation for one in orders if a full breach of the peace occurs, one must make amends for the sixth rank with six pounds in addition to the standard wergild, and with divine penance.
Und wenn tödtliche Verletzung eintritt: ausser dem gesetzlichen Wergeld beim sechsten Ordo als Klerusbusse 6 Pfund zur Busse, neben geistlicher Poenitenz.
And if fatal injury occurs: besides the lawful wergild, for the sixth grade 6 pounds as compensation for orders, with spiritual penance.
